page.overview:
What is Moose-sized critter?

A species of moose-like animal was native to the jungle planet of LV-832. The creatures possessed tentacles in place of antlers, and had green skin and hooves. The United States Colonial Marine Corps battled the creatures using M41A Pulse Rifles; First Lieutenant Hank Reynolds recalled the experience in the twenty-second episode of the first season of Saga of the Weapon, mentioning that his comrade Corporal Richards was killed by the animals.
